biggest_catch: The referred customer must enroll on a 12-month or longer plan AND pay their first two CleanSky bills before either $50 gift card is issued; cancel early and both lose the reward.
catches: Both accounts must be on eligible plans in good standing; referred must enroll on a 12-month or longer term plan via the referral link.
Reward issues only after the referred customer pays their first two bills consecutively.
Referral link/code must be used at enrollment; cannot be applied retroactively.
Gift cards (Amazon or MasterCard) cannot be redeemed for cash and are non-transferable.
Referral rewards limited to first-time customers; existing/former customers do not qualify.
W-9 issued if referral gift card total reaches $600 or more in a calendar year.
Terms subject to change at any time; see amazon.com/gc-legal for gift card restrictions.
CleanSky Energy serves deregulated Texas areas; plan rates, term, and early-termination fees still apply.
Frame as savings on planned energy spending, never income.

steps: Sign up as a CleanSky Energy customer.
Get your unique referral link from CleanSky Energy.
Share the link with friends via text, email, social media, or word of mouth.
Friend enrolls as a first-time CleanSky Energy customer on a 12-month or longer plan using your referral link at enrollment.
Friend pays their first two consecutive CleanSky bills.
Both receive a $50 Amazon.com or MasterCard gift card by email.
timing: Gift cards emailed after the referred customer pays their first two consecutive bills; no limit on number of gift cards.
